- `kuzur` = clear, `xutus` = on-table, `kazaf` = hand-empty, `masat` = holding, `neqip(x,y)` = x-on-y
- `povan` = pickup from table, `duwim` = putdown, `sexib` = stack, `pisod` = unstack

Initial towers:
- losut(table) → rogok → sasul(clear)
- rucin(table) → fotul → lacez → torem → womuv → sutij(clear)

Goal requires building tower (bottom to top): torem, losut, sasul, rucin, womuv, rogok, sutij, lacez (fotul unused, stays on table).

Strategy: disassemble both towers completely to table, then reassemble in target order.

BEGIN PLAN
(pisod sasul rogok)
(duwim sasul)
(pisod rogok losut)
(duwim rogok)
(pisod sutij womuv)
(duwim sutij)
(pisod womuv torem)
(duwim womuv)
(pisod torem lacez)
(duwim torem)
(pisod lacez fotul)
(duwim lacez)
(pisod fotul rucin)
(duwim fotul)
(povan losut)
(sexib losut torem)
(povan sasul)
(sexib sasul losut)
(povan rucin)
(sexib rucin sasul)
(povan womuv)
(sexib womuv rucin)
(povan rogok)
(sexib rogok womuv)
(povan sutij)
(sexib sutij rogok)
(povan lacez)
(sexib lacez sutij)
END PLAN
